rows.abstract: Amends BP Blg. 224 "An Act Regulating Issuance of Restraining Orders. Amends Section 5 of Rule Fifty-Eight of the Rules of Court. Provides that restraining orders issued by the Supreme Court shall be effective for a period of sixty days from the date of issuance.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 5980, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'FINANCING COMPANY ACT,' FOR THE PURPOSE OF LIBERALIZING THE FOREIGN INVESTMENTS CLIMATE IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Amends Section 6 of RA 5980. Defines Form of Organization - FINANCING COMPANIES SHALL BE ORGANIZED IN THE FORMED OF STOCK CORPORATION OR GENERAL PARTNERSHIPS AND SHALL HAVE A PAID-UP CAPITAL OF NOT LESS THAN TEN MILLION PESOS (P10.000,000.00 ).  Repeals the citizenship requirement for the Board of Director of Financing companies.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07659
